hook: Your toothpaste in space gets swallowed or wiped into a towel.
title: Your Toothpaste in Space Gets Swallowed
description:
There is no sink on the space station, and spit would float around the cabin. So astronauts either swallow their toothpaste or wipe it into a towel. Astronauts have filmed themselves brushing with a floating blob of paste.

#Shorts #Space #Astronaut

scenes.narration: Your toothpaste in space gets swallowed or wiped into a towel.
scenes.headline: SWALLOW OR WIPE

scenes.narration: There is no sink on the station.
scenes.headline: NO SINK

scenes.narration: Spit would just float around the cabin.
scenes.headline: SPIT FLOATS

scenes.narration: So the paste sits as a floating blob.
scenes.headline: FLOATING BLOB

scenes.narration: Astronauts have filmed themselves brushing on camera.
scenes.headline: FILMED ON CAMERA

scenes.narration: Others wipe their mouth with a towel.
scenes.headline: OR USE A TOWEL

scenes.narration: Your toothpaste has nowhere to go up there.
scenes.headline: NOWHERE TO SPIT
